title: Chat panel · round 2
intro: Claude Design, 22 Nov, round 2 on the built panel (main 43e13defb). Each board puts a crop of the 22 Nov test-app shot (as built) beside the ruled version. Four open choices, the designer's pick marked “recommended”: Q1 (Context ⌘I with no chips) and Q5 (Back label) and F6 (chip anatomy) on board 3, Q2 (Wiki one-time hint) on board 4.

Confirmed without options: F1 foot inset 10/12/12 (iPad sheet 12/20/20), F2 full-width secondary New session with a boxed N cap, F3 32-pt picker header “Chat · pick a session” with the hide button last, F4 ghost ‹ ⌘[ + 1×16 vertical rule, F5 bold one-line title. Q3: icon + title · sentence · primary New session N · muted hint (no chip). Q4: one copy table (board 2).

Extra drift the designer found (E): review chip by branch name, short ages (1m), the panel opens focused on the suggestion, file chip = icon + base name, chips wrap, iPad rows use Companion status glyphs. E1 (Wiki tree moved right) is not drift: that shot used Settings › Sidebar side = right.
